## Phase

MVP (policy, not code)

## Goal

The plugin is **free to use** for streaming, modification, and redistribution under GPL-2.0-or-later.

## Why GPL, not MIT

OBS plugins that link `libobs` must be GPL-compatible. GPL-2.0-or-later is what OBS and Aitum’s own plugins use. That is still free: no payment, no key, no telemetry.

## In scope

- LICENSE file (done)
- README states free to use, no paid tier
- No analytics, no phone-home, no account
- When the repo is opened to the public (if it is), the same license stays

## Acceptance

- [ ] README and LICENSE agree
- [ ] No code path that requires a license check
- [ ] Third-party libs, if any, are GPL-compatible
